PreToolUse.description: Enforce Anti-Exact-Retry invariant to halt runaway failure loops

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,pathlib,runpy; rel='scripts/guard_anti_retry.py'; cands=[d/rel for d in [pathlib.Path.cwd(),*pathlib.Path.cwd().parents]]+[pathlib.Path.home()/'.gemini'/sub/rel for sub in ('config','antigravity')]; hit=next((p for p in cands if p.is_file()),None); runpy.run_path(str(hit),run_name='__main__') if hit else print(json.dumps({'decision':'allow'}))"

PostToolUse.description: Record tool failures and clear failures on successful edits for Anti-Exact-Retry

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,pathlib,runpy; rel='scripts/guard_anti_retry.py'; cands=[d/rel for d in [pathlib.Path.cwd(),*pathlib.Path.cwd().parents]]+[pathlib.Path.home()/'.gemini'/sub/rel for sub in ('config','antigravity')]; hit=next((p for p in cands if p.is_file()),None); runpy.run_path(str(hit),run_name='__main__') if hit else print(json.dumps({'decision':'allow'}))"
